podcast.body: Kerry Livgren continued his exploration of spiritual themes with this song on Kansas's *Point of Know Return* album. The lyrics incorporate biblical references from Ecclesiastes, emphasizing the futility of human accomplishments, and Genesis, noting "for dust thou art, and unto dust thou shalt return." He also possibly borrowed themes from Emerson, Lake & Palmer's "Carnival 9." "he makes references to the Bible from Ecclesiastes... From Genesis, for dust thou art, and unto dust thou shalt return."
